# nextjs-seo-geo-blog-templates

> Four free, MIT-licensed Next.js blog templates built for SEO and GEO (generative engine optimisation): JSON-LD, llms.txt, sitemap, RSS, canonical links and Open Graph images. Stack: Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Markdown posts. They work fully on their own; the scatterpost connector is optional.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Sheldon-desouza/nextjs-seo-geo-blog-templates/blob/main/README.md): overview, features, FAQ, Deploy to Vercel buttons
- [SETUP](https://github.com/Sheldon-desouza/nextjs-seo-geo-blog-templates/blob/main/SETUP.md): Search Console, Bing, GA4 and IndexNow setup
- [AGENTS](https://github.com/Sheldon-desouza/nextjs-seo-geo-blog-templates/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guide for coding agents

## Live demos

- [Demo gallery](https://demo.scatterpost.io/)
- [Minimal](https://demo.scatterpost.io/minimal/): single column, serif, light and dark
- [Developer](https://demo.scatterpost.io/developer/): syntax highlighting, table of contents
- [Magazine](https://demo.scatterpost.io/magazine/): card grid with cover images and tags
- [Changelog](https://demo.scatterpost.io/changelog/): blog plus changelog timeline

## Optional

- [scatterpost](https://scatterpost.io): publish from an AI assistant to these templates, then share copies to Dev.to, LinkedIn and more
- [Website connector docs](https://scatterpost.io/docs/website-connector)
